subject: Route friendly patrol coordinates through Bonhomie's virtual state transition
description: This proactive source-parity correction restores Original's virtual-dispatch boundary for Friendly/Bonhomie patrol coordinates. The shared `RHArtificialIntelligence::CoordinatePatrol` prepares the patrol destination, optionally calls `StopAll`, then invokes the pure-virtual `SetState` before issuing the replacement `GoTo` (`original-code/RHartificialintelligence.cpp:7772-7835`; `original-code/RHartificialintelligence.h:1222`). For Bonhomie, that override is declared at `original-code/RHartificialbonhomie.h:37`; it records the state change, clears Default-state alert to Green, synchronously delivers the scripted AI callback, and only then installs the new state/substate (`original-code/RHartificialbonhomie.cpp:1158-1238`). Rust's Friendly event path had instead called the base patrol helper, whose fallback directly assigned state and substate and omitted those owner-specific effects. Commit `6874580ad67b8c3246f433525faae7bf70b65d4d` keeps the common patrol-plan geometry but routes Walk and Run through `FriendlyAi::set_state`; it also places any preceding `StopAll` actor work in the state callback prefix so the replacement movement remains after that synchronous boundary. The focused patrol-coordinate batch passes 4/4: the two new Friendly cases cover Walk/Run changed-state ordering and the unchanged-substate Bonhomie effects, alongside the existing Enemy and real-chief controls. This is a proactive source-and-focused parity fix: no dedicated failing representative was assigned, and no trace-frontier clearance is claimed. As a conservative non-regression check, authoritative optimized runner `/home/phire/robinhood/target/parity/examples/original_parity_replay`, built from HEAD `8a3b2424039` plus frozen diff `4bb1bc65580b`, SHA-256 `2f9737073af91081b893dcc5ee0fbdfe6a5117e25de88dbcdeffc2d73e07affc`, size 65,927,147 bytes, mtime `2026-08-11 18:19:16.263969992 +0200`, matches every recorded frame through exact EOF for `parity-random-save-replays-60s-15x/traces/Savegame_nicouzouf/Profile_001/Savegame_041/replay-007-session-0001.jsonl.zst` with `ROBINHOOD_DATA_DIR=datadirs/fullgame_linux`. The committed scope is exactly `crates/robin_engine/src/ai_friendly.rs`.
